## Set up population model 

```{r}
# Declare variables 
L <- 1000
M <- 1000
theta <- 0.1
fst1 <- 0.1
fst2 <- 0.01
```

```{r}
# Draw ancestral allele frequecies 
panc <- runif(L)
pint[panc >= 1] <- 0.99
pint[panc <= 0] <- 0.01

# Draw allele frequencies for pop A
pA <- rnorm(L, mean = panc, sd = sqrt(fst1 * panc * (1 - panc)))

# Draw intermediate split 
pint <- rnorm(L, mean = panc, sd = sqrt((fst1-fst2) * panc * (1 - panc)))
pint[pint >= 1] <- 0.99
pint[pint <= 0] <- 0.01
plot(panc, pint)

# Draw B and C
pB <- rnorm(L, mean = pint, sd = sqrt(fst2 * pint * (1 - pint)))
pC <- rnorm(L, mean = pint, sd = sqrt(fst2 * pint * (1 - pint)))
```

```{r}
# Set scale of genotypic variance
sigma2 <- 0.01

# Draw normal genotype for pop A
Ga <- matrix(NA, nrow = (1 - theta)*M , ncol = L)
for (i in 1:((1 - theta)*M)) {
  Ga[i,] <- rnorm(L, mean = pA, sd = sqrt(sigma2))
}

# Draw normal genotype for pop B
Gb <- matrix(NA, nrow = theta*M*0.5 , ncol = L)
for (i in 1:(theta*M*0.5)) {
  Gb[i,] <- rnorm(L, mean = pB, sd = sqrt(sigma2))
}

# Draw normal genotype for pop C
Gc <- matrix(NA, nrow = theta*M*0.5 , ncol = L)
for (i in 1:(theta*M*0.5)) {
  Gc[i,] <- rnorm(L, mean = pC, sd = sqrt(sigma2))
}

# Combine genotypes into single matrix
G <- rbind(Ga, Gb, Gc)
G <- scale(G)
```

```{r}
# Do eigen decomp on covariance matrix 
K <- (1/(M-1)) * (G %*% t(G))
myE <- eigen(K)

# Extract top 2 eigenvalues 
sample_e1 <- myE$vectors[,1]
sample_e2 <- myE$vectors[,2]
```
```{r}
# Construct population eigenvectors
pop_e1 <- c(rep(theta/(1- theta), (1 - theta)*M), rep(-1, theta*M)) / sqrt(theta/(1-theta))
pop_e2 <- c(rep(0, (1 - theta)*M), rep(1, theta*M*0.5), rep(-1, theta*M*0.5)) / sqrt(theta)

# Compute b2
b2 <- cor(sample_e2, pop_e2)^2
```


```{r}
simulate_normals <- function(L, M, theta, fst1, fst2) {
  
  
  # Draw ancestral allele frequencies 
  panc <- rep(0.5, L)
  panc <- pmin(pmax(panc, 0.01), 0.99)

  # Draw allele frequencies for pop A
  pA <- rnorm(L, mean = panc, sd = sqrt(fst1 * panc * (1 - panc)))
  pA <- pmin(pmax(pA, 0.01), 0.99)  # Bound values between 0.01 and 0.99

  # Draw intermediate split 
  pint <- rnorm(L, mean = panc, sd = sqrt((fst1 - fst2) * panc * (1 - panc)))
  pint <- pmin(pmax(pint, 0.01), 0.99)

  # Draw B and C
  pB <- rnorm(L, mean = pint, sd = sqrt(fst2 * pint * (1 - pint)))
  pC <- rnorm(L, mean = pint, sd = sqrt(fst2 * pint * (1 - pint)))
  pB <- pmin(pmax(pB, 0.01), 0.99)
  pC <- pmin(pmax(pC, 0.01), 0.99)

  # Define population sizes with rounding
  size_A <- round((1 - theta) * M)
  size_B <- round(theta * M * 0.5)
  size_C <- round(theta * M * 0.5)

  # Draw normal genotype for pop A
  #Ga <- matrix(rnorm(size_A * L, mean = rep(pA, each = size_A), sd = sqrt(sigma2A)), 
  #             nrow = size_A, ncol = L)
  Ga <- matrix(rbinom(size_A * L,2, rep(pA, each = size_A)), nrow = size_A, ncol = L)
  
  # Draw normal genotype for pop B
  #Gb <- matrix(rnorm(size_B * L, mean = rep(pB, each = size_B), sd = sqrt(sigma2BC)), 
  #             nrow = size_B, ncol = L)
  Gb <- matrix(rbinom(size_B * L,2, rep(pB, each = size_B)), nrow = size_B, ncol = L)

  # Draw normal genotype for pop C
  #Gc <- matrix(rnorm(size_C * L, mean = rep(pC, each = size_C), sd = sqrt(sigma2BC)), 
  #             nrow = size_C, ncol = L)
  Gc <- matrix(rbinom(size_C * L,2, rep(pC, each = size_C)), nrow = size_C, ncol = L)

  # Combine genotypes into single matrix
  G <- rbind(Ga, Gb, Gc)
  G <- scale(G)

  # Do eigen decomposition on covariance matrix 
  K <- (1/(M-1)) * (G %*% t(G))
  myE <- eigen(K)

  # Extract top 2 eigenvalues 
  sample_e1 <- myE$vectors[,1]
  sample_e2 <- myE$vectors[,2]

  # Construct population eigenvectors
  pop_e1 <- c(rep(-theta, size_A), rep(1 - theta, size_B + size_C)) / (theta * sqrt(((theta^2 + 1)/theta) - 1))
  pop_e2 <- c(rep(0, size_A), rep(1, size_B), rep(-1, size_C)) / sqrt(theta)

  # Compute b2
  b2_e1 <- cor(sample_e1, pop_e1)^2
  b2_e2 <- cor(sample_e2, pop_e2)^2  

  return(list(b2_e1 = b2_e1, b2_e2 = b2_e2))
}

```

```{r}
# Define parameter values
theta_vals <- exp(seq(log(0.01), log(0.7), length.out = 8))
fst1_vals <- c(0.8)
fst2_vals <- c(0.25, 0.5, 0.125)
reps <- 1:10  # 20 replicates
M <- 5e+02
L <- 1e+02


# Generate all combinations of parameters and replicates
param_grid <- expand.grid(rep = reps, theta = theta_vals, fst1 = fst1_vals, fst2 = fst2_vals)

# Function to apply simulate_normals_optimized() for each row
run_simulation <- function(rep, theta, fst1, fst2) {
  simulate_normals(L = L, M = M, theta = theta, fst1 = fst1, fst2 = fst2)
}

# Apply function over all parameter combinations
results <- param_grid %>%
  mutate(simulation = pmap(list(rep, theta, fst1, fst2), run_simulation)) %>%
  unnest_wider(simulation, names_sep = "_")  # Split list column into separate columns

# Rename extracted columns
colnames(results)[colnames(results) == "simulation_1"] <- "b2_e1"
colnames(results)[colnames(results) == "simulation_2"] <- "b2_e2"

```


```{r}
# Define theta range
theta_seq <- seq(0.01, 0.7, length.out = 1000)

# Create a data frame with all combinations of theta and fst1 values
df <- expand_grid(theta = theta_seq, fst2 = fst2_vals) %>%
  mutate(
    lambda = (1 + (M * (theta)*fst2)),
    pc2 = case_when(
      lambda > (1 + sqrt(M/L)) ~ (1 - ((M/L)/(lambda - 1)^2))/(1 + ((M/L)/(lambda - 1))),
      lambda <= (1 + sqrt(M/L)) ~ 0
    )
  )

# Plot using ggplot with different colors for each fst1 value
ggplot(df, aes(x = theta, y = pc2, color = factor(fst2))) +
  geom_line(size = 1.2) +
  labs(
    x = expression(theta),
    y = expression(b^2),
    color = expression(fst[2])  # Label for legend
  ) +
  theme_minimal() + scale_x_log10() + geom_point(data = results, aes(x = theta, y = simulation_b2_e2))
```



## Theory PC 1

```{r}
# Define parameters
M <- 5e5  
L <- 1e5  
fst1_values <- c(0.01, 0.1, 0.2)
fst2 <- 0.01

# Define theta range
theta_seq <- seq(0.01, 0.99, length.out = 1000)

# Create a data frame with all combinations of theta and fst1 values
df <- expand_grid(theta = theta_seq, fst1 = fst1_values) %>%
  mutate(
    lambda = (1 + ((M * (1- theta)) * ((4 * fst1) - fst2))) / log(2*M),
    pc1 = case_when(
      lambda > (1 + sqrt(M/L)) ~ (1 - ((M/L)/(lambda - 1)^2))/(1 + ((M/L)/(lambda - 1)))  ,
      lambda <= (1 + sqrt(M/L)) ~ 0
    )
  )

# Plot using ggplot with different colors for each fst1 value
ggplot(df, aes(x = theta, y = pc1, color = factor(fst1))) +
  geom_line(size = 1.2) + ylim(0,1) + 
  labs(
    x = expression(theta),
    y = expression(b^2),
    color = expression(fst[1])  # Label for legend
  ) +
  theme_minimal() + scale_x_log10()
```

## Theory PC 2

```{r}
# Define parameters
M <- 5e3  
L <- 1e3  
fst1 <- 0.5
fst2_values <- c(0.25, 0.5, 0.125)

# Define theta range
theta_seq <- seq(0.01, 0.8, length.out = 1000)

# Create a data frame with all combinations of theta and fst1 values
df <- expand_grid(theta = theta_seq, fst2 = fst2_values) %>%
  mutate(
    lambda = (1 + (M * (theta)*fst2)) / log(2*M),
    pc2 = case_when(
      lambda > (1 + sqrt(M/L)) ~ (1 - ((M/L)/(lambda - 1)^2))/(1 + ((M/L)/(lambda - 1))),
      lambda <= (1 + sqrt(M/L)) ~ 0
    )
  )

# Plot using ggplot with different colors for each fst1 value
ggplot(df, aes(x = theta, y = pc2, color = factor(fst2))) +
  geom_line(size = 1.2) +
  labs(
    x = expression(theta),
    y = expression(b^2),
    color = expression(fst[2])  # Label for legend
  ) +
  theme_minimal() + scale_x_log10()
+ geom_point(data = dfPlot, aes(x = theta, y = simulation_b2_e2, color = fst2))
```
